notes_for_editor: Thin record: a state listing, a TopoQuest location entry, an OpenStreetMap point and a village article. No build date, builder, staffing, fire or site description found after two web searches and reads of the cached crawl. The Wikipedia citation is used only for the village name, not for the tower. Not used: Wisconsin Historical Society records HI24672 (Jump River) and HI24674 (Perkinstown), both 1934 Taylor County towers that surfaced in searches; they are different towers.
